headline: Bush order gives the ITER international fusion energy group legal privileges and immunities in the United States.
what_it_does: This order names the ITER International Fusion Energy Organization, a multinational group working on fusion energy research, as a public international organization under US law. That status lets the organization receive certain privileges, exemptions, and immunities, such as some protections from lawsuits or taxes, that US law allows for groups like this. The title does not say exactly which privileges apply or whether any limits were set.

who_it_affects.how: It gains legal protections in the US that international organizations can receive, such as certain immunities and exemptions.
They may receive some of the legal privileges that US law gives to staff of designated international organizations.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 19, 2007; the exact effective date is not stated in the title.
